retained: Remove unreachable worker-result fallback and unnecessary void union
decision.reason: Keep the direct dead-code cleanup for clarity. Combined cleanup timings are unfavorable and noisy, so the timestamp helper is not retained; its individual effect is not established. The range rewrite regresses short-header batches under allocation pressure and additionally splits empty strings.

finalState.existingLocalArtifact: The build also emits an unreferenced empty shared-context.js from the pre-existing untracked type-only source. It is absent from the tracked-source baseline and is never imported by the engine or benchmark.
finalState.timingScope: The crawl comparison measures both proposed cleanups together, not the final worker-only change. No speedup or measured non-regression is claimed for the retained change.

scope.crawl: Twelve binary inputs or six markup documents; concurrency eight, two workers, default Got. Buffered and markup use the default disabled remote-mtime option; streamed and local enable it and verify every output timestamp. Total time includes initialization and disposal. Before versus both simplifications together; no attribution between changes.
scope.range: Actual emitted current isBytesAccepted function extracted into a standalone module, versus the proposed optional-chain split/includes function. Node 24.18.0, 64 MiB old-space limit, 1 MiB semi-space, 24 MiB retained JavaScript double array, rolling 256 KiB retention and 4 MiB temporary array allocations per observation. 131072 calls, short mixed headers or lists of 16 tokens. No networking or engine imports.
scope.allocation: Three separate profiling processes per implementation, sampled at 4096 bytes with collected objects included. Sampling estimates cumulative allocation, not live heap size or exact byte accounting. Instrumented timings never contribute to timing comparisons.

suites.method: Serial fresh processes; balanced three-variant rounds. Discard one warm-up per case and use one process median as the observation unit.
suites.noiseRule: Four-million-operation CPU probes bracket each timed observation. Five warm-ups and nine calibrations fix a 1.5x median threshold before each suite. Reject the entire three-variant round for a case if any measured probe exceeds the threshold. Require four qualifying rounds; no added rounds or outcome-based exclusions.

allocations.note: V8 sampled cumulative allocation estimates, including objects collected by minor and major GC. Inlining can omit the isBytesAccepted frame: parserBytes covers only surviving named frames, not all parser allocations. splitBytes and includesBytes sum builtin frames anywhere in the stack. estimatedBytes includes workload churn. Instrumented timings are excluded.
